name: Jump The Shark
effect: HIT: +1 Power for every 4 cards in your sealed area (max of +5).

name: Barnstorming

boost.name: Weight Of Regret
effect: At the end of each Strike, if your attack did not hit the opponent, you may return it to your hand instead of discarding it.
HIT: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
AFTER: Advance as far as possible.

name: Cabstand

boost.name: One More Ride
effect: Instead of drawing at the end of your turn, you may return a card from your sealed area to your hand.
BEFORE: Spend up to 3 Force. For each Force spent, Close 1.

name: Flight 13

boost.name: Outrun The Past
effect: Before you set cards for a Strike, you may seal up to 4 cards from your discard pile or Gauge. For every 2 cards sealed this way, draw a card.
BEFORE: You may discard up to 3 cards from the top of your deck. For each card discarded this way, Retreat 1.

name: Bus Stop

boost.name: Fractured Memories
effect: When you reveal your attack, if a copy is in your sealed or transformation area, it is considered an EX attack.
HIT: Push 2, then you may spend up to 2 Force. For each Force spent, +1 Power.

boost.name: Daredevil
effect: NOW: Seal up to 4 cards from the top of your deck. For each card sealed this way, +1 Speed.

name: Hellward Bound

boost.name: Hellraiser
effect: Both players discard the top 4 cards of their deck. You may return up to 2 cards from your sealed area to your hand.
If there are no cards in your deck and discard pile, this card's Gauge Cost is reduced to 0.
